Metadata.title: avalis – The Digital Solution for Accommodation Processes at Swiss Universities
Metadata.description: avalis brings the accommodation process at Swiss universities together in one digital solution. Register to receive the research report and project updates.

Footer.tagline: avalis is an independent project for the accommodation process at Swiss universities.

Hero.headline: The digital solution for accommodation processes at Swiss universities
Hero.lead: The accommodation process is fragmented and resource-intensive today. avalis brings it together in one digital solution and makes it transparent for everyone involved.
Hero.imageLabel: Placeholder for a screenshot of the prototype

Team.headline: Who is behind avalis
Team.lead: avalis is built by a three-person team with a design background. In the video, we share how we got into the topic and why it matters to us.

Solution.headline: One process, many handoffs
Solution.problemBody: The accommodation process spans multiple stages and parties. Today it mostly runs over email, PDF, and spreadsheets: requests get stuck at handoffs, and status is often not visible to those affected.
Solution.solutionBody: avalis brings the process together in one digital solution, from submitting a request through approval to implementation. Applicants, advisory offices, decision-making bodies, exam scheduling, lecturers, and exam administrators are all connected. Built on nationwide research, modular, and adaptable to each university's process structures.
Solution.videoContext: A short walkthrough shows how the request process works in avalis.
Solution.statusNote: avalis is a functional prototype tested with subject-matter experts. It is not intended for productive use.

Registration.title: Register to receive the Research Report
Registration.lead: It is based on a nationwide survey across 17 universities, combining interviews, questionnaires, and an analysis of official process documents. The report shows how the accommodation process actually works at Swiss universities today and where it runs into limits. Registering also gets you occasional updates on the development of avalis. You can unsubscribe at any time; we never share your data with third parties.
